screens.name: 01-welcome
screens.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE high fidelity desktop DreamThread app screen, landscape 16:10, straight-on edge-to-edge screenshot, no device frame, no multiple screens. Use the reference image as the strict visual design system. SAME minimalist professional midnight navy background, faint gradient, matte navy panels, hairline muted lavender borders, soft lavender primary actions, off-white text, muted secondary text, refined serif page headings paired with crisp sans-serif UI, consistent 12px rounded panels, spacious grid. Keep dreamy character restrained with small atmospheric illustrations only; no busy stars, neon, giant glow, or fantasy scenery behind text. Readable concise text. DreamThread crescent logo. Signed-in screens use same 230px left sidebar, Home, Journal, Constellation, Dream Detective, Settings at bottom; small top-right avatar Sarah. Extra features accessible through contextual tabs. Use dates in October 2026. Illustrative demo data, tentative interpretations and verifiable source affordances. No medical or prophetic claims. Create a complete coherent professional screen, not wireframe.
Welcome and sign-in screen, no signed-in sidebar. Top left crescent DreamThread. Refined two-column layout; left beautifully restrained miniature constellation of five tiny dream thumbnails and thin connected lines in generous navy negative space, headline 'The living memory of your dreams.' and short 'Capture your dreams. Discover the threads between them.' Right clean compact authentication card 'Your journal begins here', email and password fields, 'Continue' primary, 'Continue with Google' secondary, sign-in/create-account toggle, 'Your entries are private to your account.' and Terms / Privacy footer. Tasteful small type, no grandiose imagery.
